lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr12Cr6C6 (reduced formula Sr2CrC) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 148), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers with nine neighbors (2 Cr, 7 Sr), chromium centers with eight neighbors (5 Sr, 3 C), and strontium centers with thirteen neighbors (9 C, 4 Cr). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between C- and Sr-centered polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Sr-centered polyhedra.
